coupons_type_value.name: coupons_type_value
coupons_type_value.value: ("coupons"."type" = 'percent' and "coupons"."value" > 0 and "coupons"."value" <= 90) or ("coupons"."type" = 'fixed' and "coupons"."value" > 0) or ("coupons"."type" = 'free_delivery' and "coupons"."value" is null)

coupons_numbers.name: coupons_numbers
coupons_numbers.value: "coupons"."used_count" >= 0 and coalesce("coupons"."usage_limit", 1) > 0 and coalesce("coupons"."per_customer_limit", 1) > 0 and coalesce("coupons"."max_discount", 1) > 0 and coalesce("coupons"."min_order", 0) >= 0
